exercises.name: Quad Sets
exercises.description: Tighten the muscle on top of the thigh and hold.
tips: Press the knee into the floor
contraindications: Avoid if acute knee swelling is present
exercises.startPosition: Sit with the affected leg straight out in front of you
exercises.movement: Tighten the thigh, pressing the back of the knee down. Hold 5 seconds
exercises.endPosition: Release and let the leg rest flat

notes: Progress gradually; stop any movement that sharpens pain.
